_about: The case studies on the site. Each report .md is exactly what AutoDebug wrote; the short texts here summarise it for the table and player. After editing, run: python tools/case_studies.py
recorded: Recorded on Godot 4.8 (dev build, commit cafc17a), Windows 11 and Visual Studio 2026. The agent was Grok 4.7. The videos have no sound.

cases.title: ConfigFile glues trailing text onto the next key
cases.cause: parse_tag_assign_eof returns OK as soon as the value parses and never reads the rest of the line, so a trailing comma becomes the start of the next key.
cases.fix: After the value, finish the line: skip spaces and comments; anything else is a parse error.

cases.title: Signal connect treats two different arrays as the same callable
cases.cause: VariantCallable::compare_equal compares only hashes. Two different arrays with the same values hash the same, so connect thinks the signal is already connected.
cases.fix: Compare the method and identity_compare of the bound value, not the hash.

cases.title: Callable.is_valid() is false for native static methods
cases.cause: is_valid asks has_method on GDScriptNativeClass, which only knows its own method new, so a static method like FileAccess.file_exists looks invalid.
cases.fix: Let GDScriptNativeClass answer has_method for static ClassDB methods.

cases.title: Constant Dictionary stores an Array where a PackedStringArray belongs
cases.cause: The typed slot is filled with operator[], which keeps the plain Array. Indexing it later as a PackedStringArray reads size 0 and fails.
cases.fix: Store entries with Dictionary::set() and reject the constant if it fails.

cases.title: Inner-class lambda default is resolved from the outer class
cases.cause: The outer class checks for pending lambdas before its inner class body is resolved, so the inner lambda is still pending and GDScript reports a bug.
cases.fix: Resolve inner class bodies before the pending-lambda check.
